exam_scheme.note: The ICAR All India Competitive Examination for award of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) for Ph.D. admissions (AICE-JRF/SRF-PhD) is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). It serves as the national gateway for doctoral admissions and fellowship grants across 72 specialized subjects in State Agricultural Universities (SAUs), ICAR Deemed Universities (IARI, IVRI, NDRI, CIFE), and Central Agricultural Universities. The test is a single Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 minutes (2 hours) duration comprising 120 multiple-choice questions (480 marks) divided into three sections: Section A (20 questions on General Agriculture / Reasoning), Section B (50 questions on the Core Subject Group), and Section C (50 questions on the Specialized Sub-subject). Marking scheme: +4 marks for each correct response, -1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking), and 0 for unattempted questions.
